yoonPreview.title: Yoon Layout Preview Arena
yoonPreview.desc: Compare 4 visual layout solutions to address the right-side blank space in Yoon combination characters.
yoonPreview.option1Title: Option 1: Educational Bento Box Side Panel
yoonPreview.option1Desc: Cards retain exact dimensions matching Gojuon & Dakuon, while the 40% empty space on the right is utilized as a dynamic learning guide.
yoonPreview.option2Desc: Displays two Yoon groups side by side. Fills the screen seamlessly with zero blank space and reduces page height by 50%.
yoonPreview.option3Desc: Mirrors the 5-column structure of Gojuon row Y, placing tactile patterned placeholder boxes in columns 4 and 5.
yoonPreview.option4Desc: Restricts the Yoon container width (max-w-3xl) to center the 3 columns cleanly without left-heavy balance.
yoonPreview.bentoFormulaDesc: -I vowel kana merged with smaller ya (ゃ), yu (ゅ), or yo (ょ).
yoonPreview.bentoRuleDesc: Pronounced as a single continuous syllable in one breath, not spelled as two separate beats.
yoonPreview.bentoSizeDesc: The secondary kana is written at 1/4 to 1/2 the size of the primary kana at the lower right.
yoonPreview.bentoStatDesc: Consists of 7 base Gojuon groups + 4 voiced Dakuon groups.
yoonPreview.formulaVisual: [ き / KI ] + [ ゃ / YA ] = [ きゃ / KYA ]
